name: Ivory Anvil Lighthouse Paperweight

name: Golden Handcuffs Key

name: Minotaur Hoof Pincushion

flavorText: Alabaster statuette of the goddess Dibella emerging from her bath, inscribed 'House of Dibella, Anvil.'
name: Alabaster Dibella Statuette

name: Reman Dynasty Nesting Dolls

name: Ornamental Varla Stone

flavorText: Picturesque ceramic stein with hinged silver lid inscribed, 'Enrick's Pub: 200 Years of the Finest Ale!'
name: Silver-Lidded Commemorative Stein

title: Aquilarios Crest Hunting Horn
flavorText: Minotaur hunting horn engraved with the crest of House Aquilarios and the phrase, 'Hounds Halloo!'
name: Aquilarios Crest Hunting Horn

title: Dibellan Sibyl Finger Cymbals
flavorText: Several sacred silver finger cymbals assembled with Dibellan symbols for a Sibyl of the chapel to jangle.
name: Dibellan Sibyl Finger Cymbals

title: Diocletia's Pattern Book, Autographed

name: Diocletia's Pattern Book, Autographed

title: Lord Jarol's Marathon Trophy
flavorText: Stylized gold statuette of a runner in full stride, inscribed 'Second Place, Lord Jarol's Marathon, 2E 576.'
name: Lord Jarol's Marathon Trophy

title: Antique Anti-Venom Toadstone
flavorText: Silver coffer containing a polished, semi-precious toadstone, once thought to neutralize poison if placed in a drink.
name: Antique Anti-Venom Toadstone

title: Bejeweled Dwarven Metal Dog Bowl
flavorText: Rare Dwemeri bowl converted to a pet's food dish, with the name 'Snarly' picked out in precious stones.
name: Bejeweled Dwarven Metal Dog Bowl

title: House Jarol Folding Parasol
flavorText: Folding parasol with ivory ribs and lavender silk panels, one of which is embroidered with the House Jarol crest.
name: House Jarol Folding Parasol

title: "Investiture of the Primate" Tapestry
flavorText: Carefully-folded tapestry by the famous loom artist Gloria Medilus depicting the holy investiture of Primate Artorius.
name: "Investiture of the Primate" Tapestry

title: Deluxe Silver-Handled Leg Exerciser
flavorText: Top-of-the-line silvered 'Thigh Lord' leg exerciser, hardly used, engraved 'Happy Anniversary, Dearest.'
name: Deluxe Silver-Handled Leg Exerciser

title: "Fata Morgana" Crystal Fairy Castle
flavorText: Fanciful and mildly-enchanted cut-glass crystal castle, hovers twinkling in the air one foot above whatever surface it's over.
name: "Fata Morgana" Crystal Fairy Castle

title: Infernal Prayer Rug with Black Candles
flavorText: Round hand-knotted rug of red wool with silver fringe and large black handprint symbol, with 13 black candles, partly burned.
name: Infernal Prayer Rug with Black Candles

title: Dibellan Sibyl's Golden Feather Boa
flavorText: Luxurious golden scarf made from the dyed pinfeathers of 1,000 chub loons, as worn by Sibyls of Dibella.
name: Dibellan Sibyl's Golden Feather Boa

title: Noble's White Satin Burial Shroud
flavorText: Lavish Imperial noble's burial shroud, five paces of the finest white satin, labeled 'Iocanis Medilus, Stylemaster.'
name: Noble's White Satin Burial Shroud

title: Coin-Concealing Under-Doublet Money Belt
flavorText: Superb hundred-drake padded money belt, worn under a noble's attire, labeled 'Compliments of Anvil Repository.'
name: Coin-Concealing Under-Doublet Money Belt

title: Akatosh Chanter's New Life Stole
flavorText: Ceremonial silk and satin stole with embroidered hourglasses, as worn by Akatosh Chanters during the New Life Festival.
name: Akatosh Chanter's New Life Stole

title: Antique Akatosh Primate's Crosier
flavorText: Akatosh Primate's crosier with golden hourglass at its finial, in the style of the reign of Empress Hestra.
name: Antique Akatosh Primate's Crosier

title: Rain-Repellent "Umbrella Bird"
flavorText: Exquisite sateen-feathered mock bluebird with epaulet-clip, mildly enchanted to repel raindrops from the wearer.
name: Rain-Repellent "Umbrella Bird"

title: Anvil Ironworks Razor and Strop
flavorText: Aristocrat's deluxe straight razor, engraved 'Anvil Ironworks,' with matching strop of minotaur hide.
name: Anvil Ironworks Razor and Strop

title: Cap'n Slitweasand's Silken Eye Patch
flavorText: Black silken eye patch of Cap'n Goreius the Weasand-Slitter, notorious pirate of the Akaviri Potentate period.
name: Cap'n Slitweasand's Silken Eye Patch

title: Bottle of Rare "Sanguine's Rose" Perfume
flavorText: Small scarlet bottle of rare and expensive 'Sanguine's Rose' perfume, reputed to have aphrodisiacal properties.
name: Bottle of Rare "Sanguine's Rose" Perfume

title: Ancient Ayleid Insect Eliminator
flavorText: Small blue glowing crystal set in a metallic floral mount; magically slays intruding insects with tiny lightning bolts.
name: Ancient Ayleid Insect Eliminator

title: Art Book, "Allure of the Sweetroll"
flavorText: Rare art book, 'Ong's Passion: Allure of the Sweetroll,' depicting healthy unclad Imperials holding artfully placed sweetrolls.
name: Art Book, "Allure of the Sweetroll"

title: Exquisite Carved Reman-Era Fan
flavorText: Antique folding fan, exquisitely carved from some kind of dark chitin, dating from the brief reign of Emperor Kastav.
name: Exquisite Carved Reman-Era Fan

title: Imperial Coronation Invitation
flavorText: This ornate invitation, a souvenir of the coronation of Varen Aquilarios, is imprinted with gold leaf on fine parchment.
name: Imperial Coronation Invitation

title: Dibella Prayer Token
flavorText: This silver token from the Great Chapel of Dibella is inscribed with a prayer honoring the goddess of beauty and love.
name: Dibella Prayer Token

title: Gold Coast Trading Signet Ring
flavorText: A metal signet ring used to seal the official documents of the Gold Coast Trading Company with sealing wax.
name: Gold Coast Trading Signet Ring

title: Brass Anvil Paperweight
flavorText: A brass paperweight made to look like a miniature blacksmith's anvil, bearing the seal of the city of Anvil.
name: Brass Anvil Paperweight

title: Constable's Badge
flavorText: A silver-plated badge carried by constables who work for the Kvatch Vigalents.
name: Constable's Badge

title: Gottshaw Inn Beer Stein
flavorText: A beer stein with a hinged cover, inscribed with the name of The Gottshaw Inn and Tavern.
name: Gottshaw Inn Beer Stein

title: Red-Sails Pirate Flag
flavorText: A folded flag of red silk, bearing the symbol of the Karthman Red-Sails: a fanged skull with an eye patch.
name: Red-Sails Pirate Flag

title: Kvatch Arena Champion's Trophy
flavorText: A trophy given out to tournament winners and champions who survive the Kvatch Arena.
name: Kvatch Arena Champion's Trophy

title: Ship's Sextant
flavorText: A ship's sextant made of polished brass.
name: Ship's Sextant

title: Taxidermy Sep Viper
flavorText: A Sep Viper, stuffed and mounted in an attack pose, with its Dragon-like wings extended.
name: Taxidermy Sep Viper

title: Mechanical Rat Trap
flavorText: A well-made spring-loaded device used to kill rats and other vermin.
name: Mechanical Rat Trap

title: Stone of St. Alessia Replica
flavorText: A costume jewelry replica of a famous amulet sacred to the followers of St. Alessia.
name: Stone of St. Alessia Replica

title: Stuffed Minotaur Toy
flavorText: A stuffed child's toy made to look like a smiling minotaur.
name: Stuffed Minotaur Toy

title: Anvil Lighthouse Model
flavorText: A scale model of the lighthouse in Anvil's harbor, which overlooks Anvil Castle.
name: Anvil Lighthouse Model

title: Portrait of Rislav the Righteous
flavorText: A portrait, done in oils, of Rislav Larich, former King of Skingrad.
name: Portrait of Rislav the Righteous

title: All-Flags Navy Tapestry
flavorText: A woven tapestry depicting the story of the All-Flags Navy and their voyage to do battle with the Sload of Thras.
name: All-Flags Navy Tapestry

title: Pirate's Spy Glass
flavorText: A ship's spyglass, crafted of brass and bone, bearing the name of the pirate ship 'Maiden.'
name: Pirate's Spy Glass

title: Arrow Fletching Kit
flavorText: A leather case containing a fletching jig, an assortment of feathers, and twine, used for fletching arrows.
name: Arrow Fletching Kit

title: Everlasting Candles
flavorText: A package of dining room candles specially enchanted so that they will light, but never melt.
name: Everlasting Candles

title: Leather Wineskin
flavorText: A wineskin crafted of soft doeskin with a detachable shoulder strap.
name: Leather Wineskin

title: Leather Riding Crop
flavorText: A nobleman's riding crop made out of hardened, braided leather.
name: Leather Riding Crop

title: Falconer's Glove
flavorText: A heavy leather glove fitted with restraining straps, used by hunters with trained falcons.
name: Falconer's Glove

title: Toy Ballista
flavorText: A working scale model of a ballista siege weapon, lovingly crafted of rosewood.
name: Toy Ballista

title: Metalworker's Hand Saw
flavorText: A small, fine-toothed hand saw specifically designed to cut through metal.
name: Metalworker's Hand Saw

title: Picnic Set
flavorText: A leather day pack specifically designed to hold plates, cups, cutlery, and food for picnics in the outdoors.
name: Picnic Set

title: Fossilized Draugr Skull
flavorText: This ancient, fossilized skull of an undead creature has a horned helm covered with runes permanently fused to it.
name: Fossilized Draugr Skull

title: Game Board and Playing Pieces
flavorText: A gameboard with an inlaid hexagonal grid and carved bone playing pieces, used for the popular game 'Spoils of War.'
name: Game Board and Playing Pieces

title: Silver Serving Platter
flavorText: A silver filigreed serving plate used for serving meat and cheeses.
name: Silver Serving Platter

title: Sculpting Tools
flavorText: A small hammer and set of chisels, used by stone sculptors to create statues, bas reliefs, and other carvings.
name: Sculpting Tools

title: Shipwreck In A Bottle
flavorText: A detailed shipwreck model bafflingly constructed inside a glass bottle with a tiny neck.
name: Shipwreck In A Bottle

title: Theatrical Makeup Kit
flavorText: A hinged metal box containing grease pencils, brushes, tubes of greasepaint, and several fake beards and mustaches.
name: Theatrical Makeup Kit

title: Transforming Werewolf Doll
flavorText: A rubbery doll of some unknown material that reshapes itself from the form of a Nord into a werewolf when placed in hot water.
name: Transforming Werewolf Doll

title: River Troll Marionette
flavorText: A marionette puppet, manipulated from above by strings, in the form of a hideously ugly River Troll.
name: River Troll Marionette

title: Fisherman's Tackle Box
flavorText: A hinged wooden box carved with images of fish and other marine creatures, with a set of nested storage trays inside.
name: Fisherman's Tackle Box

title: Well-Made Fishing Net
flavorText: A large, intricately braided fisherman's net of unusually high quality.
name: Well-Made Fishing Net

title: Mudcrab Trap
flavorText: A submersible trap crafted from a wooden crate and netting, designed to capture live mudcrabs.
name: Mudcrab Trap

title: Miniature Fiddle
flavorText: A tiny but fully functional stringed fiddle and bow.
name: Miniature Fiddle

title: Khajiiti Dream Dice
flavorText: Carved multi-sided dice inscribed with runes denoting good or bad fortune, superstitiously thought to interpret dreams.
name: Khajiiti Dream Dice

title: Order of the Hour Prayer Candle
flavorText: An ornate candle intended to suggest the recitation of various prayers to Akatosh at intervals, as the candle burns down.
name: Order of the Hour Prayer Candle

title: The Constellations of Nirn
flavorText: A picture book guide to finding and recognizing the constellations in the night skies of Nirn.
name: The Constellations of Nirn

title: Dwarven Measurement Converter
flavorText: A metal sliding rule that purportedly converts Dwemer weights and measures to standard Imperial.
name: Dwarven Measurement Converter

title: Khajiiti Moondial
flavorText: A brass Khajitti device used to tell time using the positions and phases of the moons, Jone and Jode.
name: Khajiiti Moondial

title: Unauthorized Order of the Hour Hourglass
flavorText: A fine, silver-chased hourglass. Only a limited number were created before the Order of the Hour commanded the maker to desist.
name: Unauthorized Order of the Hour Hourglass

title: Akatosh Meditation Beads
flavorText: Made from finely carved soapstone, these beads have symbols of Akatosh painted upon them.
name: Akatosh Meditation Beads

title: Golden Gaff Letter Opener
flavorText: A letter opener made from a gaff hook dipped in gold. Created to commemorate the Pirate Queen.
name: Golden Gaff Letter Opener

title: Gold Coast Trading Company Paperweight
flavorText: A solid ebony puck with 'GCTC' etched on the top. Though heavy, it is not aerodynamic enough to hurl at an enemy.
name: Gold Coast Trading Company Paperweight

title: Fashionable Mudcrab Inkwell
flavorText: A hollow, blown-glass inkwell, shaped like a mudcrab. A blown-glass Colovian fur helm screws into the top to preserve the ink.
name: Fashionable Mudcrab Inkwell

title: Imperial Prefect's Seal
flavorText: An official seal of Anvil's former Imperial Prefect. Once unique, many copies have appeared since the Pirate Queen's arrival.
name: Imperial Prefect's Seal

title: Miniature Stained Glass Parasol
flavorText: A miniature parasol made of gold and stained glass. An ingenious mechanism allows the glass leaves to unfold.
name: Miniature Stained Glass Parasol

title: Anvil Lighthouse Sundial
flavorText: A telescoping portable sundial that extends into a replica of the Anvil lighthouse. A small ruby within serves as the flame.
name: Anvil Lighthouse Sundial

title: Dibella's Night Lantern
flavorText: A handheld bullseye lantern with a single pane of red stained glass. Primarily used in brothels, they are also of use to spies.
name: Dibella's Night Lantern

title: Intricate Whittled Kvatch Cathedral
flavorText: An accurate wooden replica of Kvatch's cathedral. Mendicants of Akatosh carve these while reflecting on the concept of patience.
name: Intricate Whittled Kvatch Cathedral

title: Colovian Personal War Tent
flavorText: A large rectangle of canvas, stakes, and rope. Now rare, these portable lean-tos were distributed to workers at Varen's Wall.
name: Colovian Personal War Tent

title: Order of the Hour Candlestick
flavorText: An elaborate silver candlestick with a depiction of Akatosh coiled up from the base. A candle is placed amidst the coils.
name: Order of the Hour Candlestick

title: Letter of Fiscal Absolution
flavorText: A letter from Anvil's former Imperial Prefect, absolving the bearer of taxation for a single year.
name: Letter of Fiscal Absolution

title: County Kvatch Map Tapestry
flavorText: A slightly faded tapestry map of County Kvatch, created before the time of Varen's Rebellion.
name: County Kvatch Map Tapestry

title: Dibellan Censer
flavorText: A silver censer molded in the shape of Dibella. The incense flows from tiny holes in her flowing hair.
name: Dibellan Censer

title: Colovian Burred Elm Fur Helm Stand
flavorText: A marble-based elm stand with multiple arms pointing upward. Can hold eight Colovian fur helms at once.
name: Colovian Burred Elm Fur Helm Stand

title: Colovian Washing Bowl
flavorText: A fine silver bowl with etched imagery of past Colovian successes.
name: Colovian Washing Bowl

title: Kvatch Dressing Mirror
flavorText: A highly polished metal mirror. Standing where the etched eyes and mouth overlap your own shows the optimum viewing distance.
name: Kvatch Dressing Mirror

title: Dibellan Worry Idol
flavorText: A soapstone idol carved to look like Dibella. Said to increase the holder's romantic appeal if regularly burnished.
name: Dibellan Worry Idol

title: Anvil Lighthouse Centerpiece
flavorText: An elaborate centerpiece with five detachable serving dishes. Removing the lighthouse top provides room for a sixth.
name: Anvil Lighthouse Centerpiece

title: Gold Coast Trading Company Decanter
flavorText: A brass decanter popular on ocean-going vessels. An ingenious stopper seals if the decanter tips rapidly.
name: Gold Coast Trading Company Decanter

title: Pirate Queen Portrait
flavorText: A portrait of Anvil's Pirate Queen. The artist perfectly captured her sneer of disdain.
name: Pirate Queen Portrait

title: Minotaur Horn Warhorn
flavorText: A warhorn fashioned from a particularly large minotaur's horn. Contrary to rumor, it doesn't produce a braying sound when blown.
name: Minotaur Horn Warhorn

title: Longhouse Legion Banner Fragment
flavorText: A section of banner from one of the 'Longhouse Legions' who opposed Varen's Rebellion, recovered by the victors.
name: Longhouse Legion Banner Fragment

title: Dead Man's Astrolabe
flavorText: A trick astrolabe enchanted to subtly alter its readings. Sought after by unscrupulous sailors who wish to strand their rivals.
name: Dead Man's Astrolabe

title: Gold Coast Trading Company Sextant
flavorText: An authentic silver sextant from the Gold Coast Trading Company, provided for ten years of faithful service.
name: Gold Coast Trading Company Sextant

title: Silver Scull
flavorText: A silver-chased short oar said to produce less noise in water. Those who aren't gullible would buy it for its decorative traits.
name: Silver Scull

title: Bronzed Pirate Head
flavorText: A decapitated head encased in bronze. Purportedly of someone who displeased the Pirate Queen.
name: Bronzed Pirate Head

title: Prefect's Resignation Replica Collar
flavorText: A bejeweled silver replica of the slave collar worn by Anvil's Imperial Prefect while being paraded through its streets.
name: Prefect's Resignation Replica Collar

title: Order of the Hour Lapel Pin
flavorText: An exquisite golden lapel pin fashioned in the shape of an hourglass.
name: Order of the Hour Lapel Pin

title: Kvatch Pocket Mannequin
flavorText: A portable wooden mannequin intended for clothiers to create their fashions in miniature. Popularized in Kvatch, before the war.
name: Kvatch Pocket Mannequin

title: Bronzed Daedroth Teeth Hairpins
flavorText: A set of three bronzed daedroth teeth. Ideal for keeping unruly hair in place and less fashionable rivals in their place.
name: Bronzed Daedroth Teeth Hairpins

title: Silken Prayer Shawl of Akatosh
flavorText: A silken prayer shawl covered in tasteful symbols of Akatosh.
name: Silken Prayer Shawl of Akatosh

title: Monogrammed Colovian Fur Stockings
flavorText: A pair of Colovian fur stockings, prized for their watertight nature. This pair is monogrammed with cloth of gold.
name: Monogrammed Colovian Fur Stockings

title: Outlawed Cameo of Count Ephrem Benirus
flavorText: A once-common ivory cameo of Anvil's former count. Though the Pirate Queen ordered their destruction, a few of them remain.
name: Outlawed Cameo of Count Ephrem Benirus

title: Perfidious Accusation Sleeping Mask
flavorText: A painted mask fashioned to look like an individual's face, with open, staring eyes. Worn at night to discourage sneak-thieves.
name: Perfidious Accusation Sleeping Mask

title: Longhouse Betrayers' Chamberpot
flavorText: A silver chamberpot. Etchings of the Longhouse Emperors recoiling in fear adorn the sides.
name: Longhouse Betrayers' Chamberpot

title: "Any Port In A Storm" Boudoir Game
flavorText: Six sets of eyeless leather hoods, fur-lined restraints, and earplugs for Dibellan adherents to worship somewhat anonymously.
name: "Any Port In A Storm" Boudoir Game

title: Bejeweled Finger Cymbals
flavorText: A set of bejeweled finger cymbals, fashioned in the Taneth style.
name: Bejeweled Finger Cymbals

title: Maormer Bone Jaw Harp
flavorText: A jaw harp supposedly made from Maormer bone, which is said to be naturally springy. Highly sought after by unscrupulous bards.
name: Maormer Bone Jaw Harp

title: Fighters Guild Bounty Box
flavorText: This large box contains an Ornate Item, and a Set item.
name: Fighters Guild Bounty Box

title: Dark Brotherhood Reward Satchel
flavorText: This small satchel contains items that an assassin might find useful.
name: Dark Brotherhood Reward Satchel

title: Toxin Satchel
flavorText: This oilskin satchel, latched and sealed with wax, contains a gift from your supplier.
name: Toxin Satchel

title: Assassin's Potion Kit
flavorText: This small box contains a few potions that an assassin might find useful.
name: Assassin's Potion Kit

title: Palatine Sabertooth
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the lake waters of the Gold Coast.
name: Palatine Sabertooth

title: Hammer Bombil
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the lake waters of the Gold Coast.
name: Hammer Bombil

title: Spotted Bass
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the lake waters of the Gold Coast.

title: Sleeper Shark
flavorText: A rare fish found only in saltwater in the Gold Coast.

title: Scorpionfish
flavorText: A rare fish found only in saltwater in the Gold Coast.
name: Scorpionfish

title: Rattail
flavorText: A rare fish found only in saltwater in the Gold Coast.
name: Rattail

title: Bullface Wingfin
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the river waters of the Gold Coast.
name: Bullface Wingfin

title: Longmouth Pike
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the river waters of the Gold Coast.
name: Longmouth Pike

title: Gold Coast Crayfish
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the river waters of the Gold Coast.
name: Gold Coast Crayfish

title: Ghastly Batfish
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the foul waters of the Gold Coast.
name: Ghastly Batfish

title: Spiny Frogfish
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the foul waters of the Gold Coast.
name: Spiny Frogfish

title: Black Anvil Loach
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the foul waters of the Gold Coast.
name: Black Anvil Loach

title: The Serpent's Egg-Tooth
flavorText: On every New Life the Serpent breaks out of its Celestial Ovum to writhe across the heavens for another year, dropping its fang of ophidian ivory to Tamriel below.
name: The Serpent's Egg-Tooth

title: The Costumer's Wardrobe
flavorText: This box jostles with many Costumes, Hats, Polymorphs, and Skins.
name: The Costumer's Wardrobe

title: The Alchemist's Crate
flavorText: This box jangles with multitudinous vials of Water, Oil, and preserved Reagents.
name: The Alchemist's Crate

title: Crafter's Limitless Library
flavorText: Within this container is a series of items that will grant you Motif books based on crafting styles you do not yet know.
name: Crafter's Limitless Library

title: The Traveled Crafter's Crate
flavorText: This crate is laden with the materials to make equipment in every style and trait yet known as well as an abundance of materials necessary to craft furnishings.
name: The Traveled Crafter's Crate

title: The Crafter's Materials Crate
flavorText: This crate is heavy with refined materials.
name: The Crafter's Materials Crate

title: The Ultimate Crafting Crate
flavorText: This crate is bulging with other boxes, each full of things any crafter could want or need. If you simply can't carry everything, be sure to purchase more Inventory or Bank Space!
name: The Ultimate Crafting Crate

title: Serpent's Languid Coffer
flavorText: This weekly reward was given to you by the Undaunted for performing daring feats in the Trials of Craglorn. The items inside scale to your level at the moment you open the box.
name: Serpent's Languid Coffer

title: Serpent's Coiled Coffer
flavorText: This weekly reward was given to you by the Undaunted for performing daring feats in the Trials of Craglorn. The items inside scale to your level at the moment you open the box.
name: Serpent's Coiled Coffer

title: Crow Caller
flavorText: The rarest crow callers have been known to summon more than just birds during the Witches Festival. See what strange and sinister secrets await you!
name: Crow Caller

name: The Forgemaster's Medallion
